title: Columbia High School in Rensselaer County welcomed most students in 2025-26 school year
text:
Columbia High School in Rensselaer County welcomed most students in 2025-26 school year
Columbia High School had the highest enrollment among Rensselaer County schools, welcoming 1,328 students during the 2025-26 academic year, according to the New York State Education Department.
Data also showed that most of the students were white, representing 75.2% of Columbia High School's total enrollment.
Among the 37 schools in Rensselaer County, Troy High School ranked second in enrollment numbers with 1,172 students, while Howard L. Goff School welcomed 942 students and came in third in the 2025-26 school year.
Columbia High School is part of East Greenbush Central School District, which roughly covers seven schools within Rensselaer County and has a main office in East Greenbush.
In the previous school year, Columbia High School also had the highest number of students among Rensselaer County schools.
New York ranks second nationwide in K-12 public education spending, with current expenditures averaging $30,012 per student, nearly double the national average of $16,526, according to the Education Data Initiative.
